## Foods & dishes
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 124 recipes tagged `argentine` (ingredients without amounts, steps, nutrition).
- [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈6,040 recipes labelled Argentine in v1, but this looks like a default label for most of the `South American` region (7,176); not released.
- Dish inventories: [[WorldCuisines]] 25 dishes (3 Argentina-only; many shared with Uruguay/Chile, e.g. alfajor, empanada); [[FmLAMA]] 13 dishes (e.g. locro, chocotorta, dulce de leche); [[World Wide Dishes]] 2 (shared).
- Backlog: [[RecetasDeLaAbuela]] (priority 3, open-download): Spanish-language recipes labelled by Spanish-speaking country; per-country counts not known yet.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table in the vault or `Backlog/`; [[USDA FoodData Central]] is the fallback.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 180 plants on the map; [[NPASS]] 51 specimen pairs.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 198 ethnobotany records, 117 taxa. [[KNApSAcK Family]] has a World-map page for it (edible/medicinal species records), not scraped, so no count in the vault.
- [[Exposome-Explorer]]: 2 rows.
- Compound → effect chains via the [[Global]] backbones ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]]).

## Gaps
- No Argentine FCT; no recipe set with amounts that is released and reliably country-labelled.
- Yerba mate, the main daily stimulant, needs a compound/effect source (check Duke/FooDB coverage).
